charts.title: Response y vs x by group
charts.caption: n=5 per group (A, B); points are individual observations; no error bars (raw scatter). Missing rows would be skipped and counted.
charts.rationale: Two continuous variables, correlation intent -> scatter with position encoding. NOT recommended: pie (no composition), line (x is not a time series and groups are unordered categories).

charts.title: Mean y by group (SD)
charts.caption: Bars = mean y per group, n=5 each; error bars = standard deviation (sd), NOT se or CI; bars start at zero baseline.
charts.rationale: Categorical comparison of a numeric outcome -> bar with length encoding and zero baseline. NOT recommended: pie/area (exaggerates differences), truncated axis (misleads).
